links.comparator_used: Prompt conditions without methodological guidance (no specification of the target, assumption or estimation procedure), across 11 OpenAI and Anthropic models and seven prompt conditions
links.outcome: Target-aligned implementation of decision dependency in LLM-generated code (and acknowledgment in explanations)
links.effect: Target-aligned implementation reached 99-100% when prompts specified the target, assumption and estimation procedure; without guidance LLMs did not reliably address decision dependency. Among frontier models, a simple description of how decisions affect outcomes appeared sufficient.
links.quote: When prompts specify the target, the assumption needed to estimate it, and the estimation procedure, target-aligned implementation reaches 99-100%.

design_hint: prompt guidance specifying target and estimation procedure
